shapeSummary: Single barrel-shaped roller with its axis along Z (length 44 mm, max diameter 20 mm at mid-length, end diameter 16 mm) and an 8 mm axial through-bore. It is centered in X and Z, and its bottom sits at Y=0, so the axis lies at Y=10.
warnings: The listing gives no dimensions. Length, diameter, end diameter and bore are estimated from the photo and the supplied bounds.
The barrel profile is a single circular arc, which is an approximation of the real curvature.
The raised dimple texture is omitted as decorative detail.
The loose pin, bearings, E-clips and shims in the pack are not modeled.
The bore is modeled as a plain 8 mm through-hole. Any bearing seats or counterbores are not visible, so they are omitted.
cadquery:
r_end=8.0
r_max=10.0
r_bore=4.0
L=44.0
profile=(cq.Workplane('XZ')
    .moveTo(r_bore,-L/2)
    .lineTo(r_end,-L/2)
    .threePointArc((r_max,0),(r_end,L/2))
    .lineTo(r_bore,L/2)
    .close())
roller=profile.revolve(360,(0,0,0),(0,1,0))
part=roller.translate((0,r_max,0))
